name: Flötemarksön - Porsås
description: Flötemarksön to Porsås. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Flötemarkens Vildmarkscamp: Private wilderness camp/service near the start. WST mentions nearby Flötemarken wilderness camping and says hut/shelter/tent booking must be arranged in advance by phone. OSM/Ställplats evidence includes customer/fee access, fresh/drinking water, toilets, shower, sauna and camping/caravan/camper context.
notes: Route geometry is partial or policy-blocked in the candidate research; inspect the section caveats before treating it as a navigable route.
Obtain authoritative full route corridor from Tanum municipality/WST or encode a deliberate partial/self-navigation model. Do not auto-stitch the gap.
Official WST and Naturkartan metadata say 14 km, but WST GPX/API and Naturkartan GPX/API compute about 4.389 km. OSM relation 4493075 and multiple route apps echo about 4.3-4.5 km.
Stage 21 GPX/API ends at [58.810347, 11.692371] near Holmen, while Porsås/Stage 22 start and official Porsås facilities are around [58.84869, 11.68317], about 4.296 km away.

Official text says markings exist only on Flötemarksön-Holmen and road 164-Porsås, with self-navigation between. Wikiloc reports no marks farther north and use of gravel road. OSM old route is no longer blazed.
WST says Loviseholm bus stop is about 2 km east of Porsås and served from Ed, but current Västtrafik stop search found no Loviseholm stop.

facilities.name: Flötemarksön trailhead map/guidepost
facilities.description: Map and guidepost at the Stage 21 start / Stage 20 end. Use as trailhead information, not evidence of full-stage geometry.

facilities.name: Roslund vindskydd cluster
facilities.description: Lean-to shelter cluster with pit toilet, fireplaces/firepit, picnic/weather shelter nearby. OSM says access=yes, fee=no, sleeping=dedicated and capacity 6. Not surfaced as official WST Stage 21 shelter. Coordinate/proximity are against the partial WST GPX only.

facilities.name: Flötemarkens Vildmarkscamp
facilities.description: Private wilderness camp/service near the start. WST mentions nearby Flötemarken wilderness camping and says hut/shelter/tent booking must be arranged in advance by phone. OSM/Ställplats evidence includes customer/fee access, fresh/drinking water, toilets, shower, sauna and camping/caravan/camper context. Private/customer/check-ahead, not public trail water or free campsite. WST phone contact from official-source lane: +46 070-5570220.

facilities.name: Holmen / mapped-GPX end navigation handoff
facilities.description: Critical navigation handoff point. Official text says the marked section runs to Holmen bridge, then hikers must navigate themselves until road 164. Not Porsås. Not a normal trail endpoint for app guidance unless partial-route mode is supported.

facilities.name: Porsås access parking
facilities.description: Small Porsås parking/access near the Stage 22 start area. OSM parking has access=permissive and capacity 3; WST says 2-3 spaces. About 4.3 km beyond the Stage 21 GPX end. Small capacity only.

facilities.name: Porsås information board
facilities.description: Information board at Porsås / Stage 22 start area. Not reached by current Stage 21 GPX linework.
